subject: System Design
title: There Is No Silver Bullet
description: Learn There Is No Silver Bullet in one minute.

hook.text: Microservices won't fix bad code. Monoliths won't fix bad teams. Architecture doesn't solve people problems.

buildup.text: All architectures have trade-offs. Monoliths trade modularity for simplicity. Microservices do the reverse.

discovery.text: The best architecture depends on team size, domain complexity, scaling needs, and organizational culture.

twist.text: Many teams chase microservices as a status symbol. Premature decomposition creates more problems than it solves.

climax.text: Choose the simplest architecture that meets your current needs. Evolve it as your requirements and team grow.

punchline.text: No architecture is universally best — context decides.

quiz.question: How should you choose between monolith and microservices?
options: Based on team size, domain complexity, and current needs
Always choose microservices for modern apps
